title: PEBR canonical national poll
description: Stable identity for one national fieldwork+scenario. Shares are fractions in [0,1]. geography is national-only in v1. TSE registration is provenance, not truth. fieldwork_end is the trend date; fieldwork_mid is the optional computed midpoint for Stats Option B dating.

poll_id.description: Stable canonical id after witness merge (see schemas/README.md).

fieldwork_end.description: Required for trend ordering; primary fieldwork date.

fieldwork_mid.description: Nullable computed midpoint of fieldwork_start..fieldwork_end (YYYY-MM-DD). Stats Option B dates polls here; pipeline may leave null until normalize computes it.

geography.description: v1 lock: national only. Never mix state into national aggregates.

scenario.description: Stable scenario key. Families: `stimulated_1st_round` (national stimulated 1º turno); `stimulated_2nd_round_<cand_a>_vs_<cand_b>` (national stimulated runoff pair; cand_a/cand_b are canonical candidate_ids sorted lexicographically ascending); also reserved: unstimulated, runoff_A_vs_B legacy alias. Never mix scenarios in one aggregate. Assemble writes 1º and 2º to separate canonical files.

moe.description: Margin of error as fraction of the share scale (e.g. 0.02 for ±2pp). Null if not published. Not a percent integer.

results.description: Map candidate_id → share as fraction in [0,1]. Do not use 0–100 percent here.

residuals.description: Residual category shares as fractions [0,1]. Keys from config/residual_categories.yml (e.g. branco, nulo, nsnr, outros).

tse_registration_id.description: Optional TSE protocol/registration id for provenance only. Never treat as sole truth for identity or results.

witness_ids.description: Coverage/publication witnesses merged into this poll.

dataset_version.description: Pipeline/dataset version stamp for this record.
